enchantment.relicweave.keen_edge.desc: Increases melee damage dealt with Swords and Axes.
enchantment.relicweave.purling.desc: Press the Purling key to throw a conjured Ender Pearl, taking no teleport damage. No pearls required.
enchantment.relicweave.cobbled_up.desc: Mining stone has a chance to drop extra cobblestone.
enchantment.relicweave.oxidation.desc: Melee hits slow the target. At level III, they also weaken it.
enchantment.relicweave.conductive.desc: Increases mining speed. Incompatible with Efficiency.
enchantment.relicweave.golemed.desc: Adds armor and knockback resistance, like an Iron Golem.
enchantment.relicweave.piglinified.desc: Piglins treat you as if you were wearing gold.
enchantment.relicweave.villagers_best_fr: Villagers give you Hero of the Village discounts.
enchantment.relicweave.the_necromancer.d: Slain monsters may rise as a Husk that fights for you for 30 seconds.
enchantment.relicweave.necromanced.desc: Undead ignore you unless you attack them. Grants immunity to Wither.
enchantment.relicweave.upbound.desc: Press Jump in mid-air to jump again, once per level.
item.relicweave.diamond_totem.save: On death: survive with 4 health, Resistance II and Regeneration II
item.relicweave.netherite_totem.save: On death: survive at half health, gain protective effects, and repel nearby mobs
item.relicweave.ultra_totem.passive: Passive: +8 Max Health, Fire Resistance, Regeneration
item.relicweave.ultra_totem.save: On death: fully heal, cleanse harmful effects, and gain powerful buffs
tooltip.relicweave.totem.offhand: Works from your offhand. Never consumed.
tooltip.relicweave.totem.either_hand: Works from either hand. Never consumed.

jei.relicweave.info.transmutation_table: Turns a material and a catalyst into an enchanted book. Put the material in the top-left slot and the catalyst in the bottom-left slot. When the arrow fills, take the book from the right slot. Ingredients are used only when the book is made. Apply books at an anvil, and combine two of the same level to level up.
jei.relicweave.info.celestial_infuser: Adds an infusion to Celestial armor. Put a Celestial armor piece in the top-left slot and an infusion material in the bottom-left slot. When the arrow fills, take the armor from the right slot. Each piece holds up to 3 different infusions, and only Celestial armor is accepted.
jei.relicweave.info.celestial_ore: Celestial Ore generates in End Stone in the End, and more rarely in Netherrack in the Nether. Mine it with a diamond pickaxe or better to get Celestial Shards (Fortune increases the drop). 4 Celestial Shards + 1 Netherite Ingot make a Celestial Ingot.
jei.relicweave.info.celestial_armor: Made by upgrading Netherite armor with a Celestial Ingot at a Smithing Table. Celestial armor can be infused at a Celestial Infuser: up to 3 different infusions per piece, each adding a bonus.
book.relicweave.guide.page14:

Pick one per
item; they are
never combined.

message.relicweave.guide_updated: RelicWeave was updated: here is the new edition of the RelicWeave Guide.
status.relicweave.machine.wrong_armor_pi: Wrong armor piece for this infusion
enchantment.relicweave.reaping.desc: Harvests and replants mature crops around the one you break. Larger area per level. Crouch to break a single crop.
enchantment.relicweave.undertow.desc: Hits on targets in water slow them, and you gain Dolphin's Grace while in water. Bosses are not slowed.
enchantment.relicweave.resonance.desc: Mining the same block type in a row speeds you up, by up to 10% per level. Switching blocks resets it.
enchantment.relicweave.soulguard.desc: Killing a hostile mob grants temporary absorption hearts. Short cooldown between grants.
enchantment.relicweave.steady_draw.desc: Move faster while drawing a bow. Does not change arrow damage or draw time.
enchantment.relicweave.reprisal.desc: Blocking a melee hit just after raising the shield weakens and slows the attacker. Bosses are only weakened.
infusion.relicweave.tidal.desc: Helmet only. Water Breathing while your head is underwater.
infusion.relicweave.warding.desc: Chestplate only. A ward softens one hit by 2 hearts, recharging every 20 s.
infusion.relicweave.pursuit.desc: Leggings only. Killing a hostile mob gives Speed II for 3 s (10 s cooldown).
infusion.relicweave.anchored.desc: Boots only. Crouching cuts knockback by 75%.
tooltip.relicweave.infusion.rule_limit: Up to 3 different infusions per piece
tooltip.relicweave.infusion.rule_stackin: Attribute infusions stack across pieces; effect infusions fit one piece and never stack
jei.relicweave.info.attunement_source: Attunement source. Transmutation Table: %s book. Celestial Infuser: %s infusion (%s). The two are separate recipes.
item.relicweave.lodestone_charm.desc: When switched on, pulls nearby dropped items toward you
item.relicweave.tidal_charm.desc: Water Breathing and better visibility underwater
item.relicweave.featherwoven_charm.desc: Halves fall damage and slows dangerous falls
item.relicweave.wayfarers_relic.desc: Sneak and use to bind a location, then channel to return to it (same dimension only)
item.relicweave.guardian_relic.desc: Grants a brief absorption shield when a hit leaves you at 3 hearts or less
message.relicweave.relic.only_passive: %s is passive: it works on its own and has nothing to activate
message.relicweave.wayfarer.unbound: Sneak and use the relic to bind a location first
message.relicweave.wayfarer.other_dimens: The bound location is in another dimension
tooltip.relicweave.relic.location.invent: Works anywhere in your inventory or a charm slot
tooltip.relicweave.relic.location.equipp: Works from your offhand or a charm slot
tooltip.relicweave.relic.activate: Press %s to activate when selected (%s to switch)
tooltip.relicweave.wayfarer.unbound: Not bound. Sneak and use to bind your location
tooltip.relicweave.echo.glowing: Glowing is visible to every player
tooltip.relicweave.totem.offhand_or_slot: Works from your offhand or a charm slot. Never consumed.
tooltip.relicweave.totem.either_hand_or_: Works from either hand or a charm slot. Never consumed.
tooltip.relicweave.gate_keystone: Place at the centre of a 3x3 ring of Concordance Frames, then use a Threshold Sigil on it.
message.relicweave.gate.incomplete: The gate is incomplete: surround the keystone with eight Concordance Frames.
message.relicweave.gate.locked: The gate does not answer. Free the End first.
message.relicweave.gate.inactive: The gate is dormant. Use a Threshold Sigil on the keystone.
message.relicweave.gate.busy: A ritual is already under way.
message.relicweave.gate.unavailable: The way is closed. The Vestige cannot be reached.
message.relicweave.gate.waystone_dormant: The waystone is silent here. It only answers inside The Vestige.
message.relicweave.rift.warning_80: Rift Saturation is critical! Get clear of the rifts.
tooltip.relicweave.ward_salve.2: Does not protect against other hazards.
message.relicweave.gravity.telegraph_up: Gravity surge rising ↑ - crouch to brace
message.relicweave.null_pocket.enter: Null Pocket — active relics are suppressed here
message.relicweave.hush.heard: Something in the fog heard you
death.attack.relicweave.starfall: %1$s was struck down by a falling star
death.attack.relicweave.starfall.player: %1$s was struck down by a falling star while fighting %2$s
message.relicweave.null_pocket.suppresse: %s is suppressed by a Null Pocket
guide.relicweave.mob.reliquary_sentinel: Wait out its raised shield, then strike while it is Exposed. Hits from behind ignore the guard.
guide.relicweave.mob.scriptbound_scribe: Close the distance while it casts; it is helpless and takes extra damage during Recovery.
guide.relicweave.mob.gilded_husk: Hit it from the side or behind, and land one big blow to crack its armor.
guide.relicweave.mob.mirebound_cantor: Hit it hard to break its chant, and stay quiet in the Hushfen or it calls its allies.
guide.relicweave.mob.oathbreaker_knight: Read the stance: attack behind its Guard, sidestep the Sweep ring and the Lunge line.
guide.relicweave.mob.vestige_drifter: Harmless unless hurt. Give it an Inscribed Page to hear a fragment of lore.
guide.relicweave.mob.rift_archer: Break line of sight when the aim line appears, then keep moving; arrows lead you.
guide.relicweave.mob.echo_weaver: Decoy bolts are harmless; leave the 5 block pulse ring when notes gather around it.
subtitles.relicweave.entity.oathbreaker_: Oathbreaker Knight winds up a sweep
Echo Weaver gathers a sonic pulse
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.0: The Crown was never a place. It was a promise made by nine hands.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.1: Pages burn, but the Archive remembers what was written on them.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.2: The Cycle does not turn for us. We simply learned to count its turning.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.3: Sentinels kept the oath long after they forgot whom it was sworn to.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.4: The fen is quiet because the fen is listening.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.5: Gold stays when the flesh does not. Ask the husks.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.6: A glyph is a held breath. Read it gently.
message.relicweave.drifter.lore.7: When the sky falls in the caldera, walk toward the light that is not falling.
message.relicweave.drifter.silent: The drifter has said all it will say for now.
guide.relicweave.mob.fracture_wisp: It telegraphs each dash with a light trail; sidestep early, then strike while it recovers.
guide.relicweave.mob.nullwing: It screeches before diving; dodge sideways, then hit it as it climbs. It lands if it cannot dive.
guide.relicweave.mob.eclipse_moth: Harmless. In Resonance and Convergence it hovers near rifts, null wards and gravity anchors.
guide.relicweave.mob.concordance_guardia: Step out of the ring after its wind-up and leave the fixed rune beam line; it speeds up below 30%.
guide.relicweave.mob.sealed_custodian: Back off while its blue dome is up; strike after it ends. Its chests stay sealed until it falls.
guide.relicweave.mob.rune_warden: Stay beyond 4 blocks to leave it asleep. Dodge the ring burst and sidestep the three-shard volley.
guide.relicweave.mob.cycle_herald: Leave its lance line before the beam fires. It fades when Convergence ends; no loot if it vanishes.
subtitles.relicweave.entity.concordance_: Concordance Guardian charges a rune beam
subtitles.relicweave.entity.sealed_custo: Sealed Custodian raises a rune shield
Rune Warden charges a rune burst
subtitles.relicweave.entity.cycle_herald: Cycle Herald charges a phase lance
message.relicweave.custodian.sealed: The Custodian's seal holds this closed.
message.relicweave.rune_warden.awaken: The runes flare; the Warden awakens.
message.relicweave.guardian.phase2: The Guardian's runes ignite: rune beam unlocked.
message.relicweave.guardian.phase3: The Guardian is enraged: faster and sharper.
guide.relicweave.mob.glassroot_stalker: Crystal shimmers in the wilds hide it. It warns before it strikes; watch for the shiver.
guide.relicweave.mob.ruin_hound: Fight with your back to a wall; hounds flank. Lone, wounded hounds flee and return.
guide.relicweave.mob.aether_grazer: Harmless. Shear it for Aether Down; the fleece regrows slowly. Sprinting scares it.
guide.relicweave.mob.shardback_brute: Dodge the slam ring and charge line. After a charge it is exposed: hit its back.
guide.relicweave.mob.starfall_strider: Do not stand in its flame trail. Sidestep the dash, then hit it while it turns.
guide.relicweave.mob.gravity_leech: Break line of sight to stop its pull; Gravity Shear protection weakens it.
guide.relicweave.mob.archive_mimic: A chest with seams and a violet keyhole is suspect. Strike first from range.
item.relicweave.smithing_template.vestig: Add netherite armor, weapon, or tool
message.relicweave.altar.slumbering: Its guardian sleeps for good (rematches are disabled on this server)
message.relicweave.seal_gate.sealed: Sealed. Only those who defeated the Warden of Seals may pass.
message.relicweave.seal_gate.blocked: Something blocks the way beyond the gate
